notes: The window counts whole UTC days from the day the check runs (today = Date.parse of today's ISO date), and a fix done exactly 14 days ago still counts; the 15th day frees it. A design item done the same day as the last fix does not reset (strict done_on > comparison).
The module-exists rule also applies to non-fix items at ready or doing that name a module, which the outcome allows but does not state.
fix-reminder-wake names packages/engine/bin/host.js, so it counts apart from the three packages/engine/src/host.js fixes (exact path match, as the item's risks say).
The world check holds through 2026-11-18; after that the same throwaway would pass, which is the rule working, not a regression.

First verdict (7e08eef, at b7305dc) found five done_on dates a day late, from a shallow clone's boundary commits; replan #185 fixed them and moved the window to 2026-11-18. The suite reads dates in UTC and will not judge a date at a shallow boundary, so CI's depth-1 checkout skips the date check.
